name: @panoma/video-brain
description: The judgement the automatic path was missing: a pluggable model — the claude or codex agent already on the machine, or an Anthropic or OpenAI key — that reads what the scout and the tour measured and answers nine typed questions: what the product is, what to click, what to say, how to fix a failing cut, how to post it. It phrases; it never states. Every answer is validated against a schema, audited against the fact sheet, cached on its inputs, capped per run and logged with its reason.
